youtube.description:
Every Friday, Ndedi at Wouri Express exports messages, strips numbers, and pastes them in to get a summary. Tanyi explains how an AI agent can automate these steps itself, with clear boundaries for safety. Learn the difference between chatbots and agents.

Chapters
0:00 Hook
0:23 Listening
0:40 Decide: chatbot or agent
1:02 Understand: the agent loop
1:26 Build
1:52 Constraint and fix
2:22 User test
2:38 Where this applies
2:52 Ownership

Fictional teaching scenario. Wouri Express and its people are invented; the setting draws on documented conditions in Douala, Cameroon.
Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
